rules: One semantic action has one interactive writer.
One current training fact has one authoritative store.
Compatibility bridges delegate; they do not regain authority.
A derived projection or resolver cannot create a second persistence model.
Flow intent may extend the established app-owned axis_v60_state but cannot become Encounter fact authority.
Temporary Flow recording context may affect only the current recording handoff and may not mutate reusable Object truth.
Classic repeated-set facts remain v61-owned even when a Flow selects the Object.
Ordinary single/complete remain one-shot; only a proven immutable Flow whole-item may reuse the existing v82/v87 Active lifecycle.
Evolution Replay is presentation-only over existing Encounter truth; it cannot persist a parallel timeline, score reality, rewrite history, or become a network/AI/media owner.
Replay-to-Evidence continuity is a transient presentation handoff; v815 remains the Evidence owner and wholly no-media Objects retain the no-pressure data-only state.
Changing an owner requires explicit handoff, regression proof, and retirement of the previous writer.
